defs.def: a person who is in charge of running a business, a shop/store or a similar organization or part of one （企业、店铺等的）经理，经营者，老板

ex.s: If you’ve ever worked as an instructor, manager, trainer or coach, you’ll know that there are few better ways to learn new information than to teach it.
ex.t: 如果你曾经担任过教官、经理、培训师或教练，你就会知道学习新知识的最好方法之一就是去教别人。

ex.s: Managers of insurance companies.
ex.t: 保险公司的经理们。

ex.s: Months later, after a job interview at another company, I got a call From the manager.
ex.t: 几个月后，在另一家公司的面试后，我接到了经理的电话。

ex.s: The manager went on to tell me I hadn’t expressed my ___20___ for applying for the position.
ex.t: 经理接着告诉我，我没有表达我申请这个职位的____20____。

ex.s: Wendy Wilson, extra care manager at 60 Penfold Street, one of the first to embark on the project, said: “Residents really welcome the idea of the project and the creative sessions.
ex.t: Penfold街60号的额外护理经理Wendy Wilson是最早参与该项目的人之一，她说："居民们非常欢迎这个项目和创意活动。

ex.s: He’s on office manager.
ex.t: 他是一名已出版作家。

ex.s: Your application will be accessed by UNESCO managers and will stay in our database for six months．We do not respond to every candidate．If selected，you will be contacted by a manager．If you do not receive any update within six months，it means that your application has not been successful．
ex.t: 你的申请将由联合国教科文组织经理审核并将保存在我们的数据库中六个月．我们不回复每位候选人．如果入选你将由经理联系．如果在六个月内没有收到任何更新这意味着你的申请未获成功．

ex.s: Contact UNESCO managers．B.
ex.t: 联系联合国教科文组织经理．B.

ex.s: In the past, there was often an automatic reaction to increased traffic: just widen the roads, says Mark Poch, the Bellevue Transportation Department’s traffic engineering manager.
ex.t: 过去，面对交通增加往往有一种自动反应：只要拓宽道路就行，贝尔维尤市交通部的交通工程经理马克·波奇说。

ex.s: I radioed the camp manager for help.
ex.t: 他告诉我直升机正在路上但要30分钟后才能到达。

ex.s: The camp manager suggested I use pepper spray.
ex.t: 喷雾会刺激熊的眼睛但不会伤害它们。

ex.s: They have to do it just like NASA engineers,” says Florence Gold, a project manager.
ex.t: "他们必须像NASA工程师一样完成工作，"她说。

ex.s: Most of our volunteers are aged 17-24.Now we need volunteer managers aged 25-75.They are extremely important in the safe and effective running of our programmes.
ex.t: 我们的大多数志愿者年龄在17-24岁。现在我们需要25-75岁的志愿者经理。他们对我们计划的安全和有效运行极其重要。

ex.s: We have such roles as project managers，mountain leaders，and communication officers.
ex.t: 我们有项目经理、登山领队和沟通官员等角色。

ex.s: Join us as a volunteer manager to develop your own skills while bringing benefits to the communities.
ex.t: 加入我们成为志愿者经理，在为社区带来益处的同时发展自己的技能。

ex.s: 31.What is the main responsibility of volunteer managers?
ex.t: 31.志愿者经理的主要职责是什么？

ex.s: A hotel manager.
ex.t: 一位酒店经理。

ex.s: Bill Shankly(1913-1981) was one of Britain's most successful and respected football managers.
ex.t: 比尔·香克利（1913-1981）是英国最成功和最受尊敬的足球经理之一。

ex.s: I’ll speak with my manager about moving to the top floor.
ex.t: 我会和我的经理谈谈搬到顶层的事情。

ex.s: Psychologist, Dr Hart Jade, 24, accounting manager As a song in Ugly Betty puts it, “It’s a pretty person’s world”.
ex.t: 心理学家哈特博士。杰德，24岁，会计经理。正如《丑女贝蒂》里的一首歌唱的，这是漂亮人的世界。

ex.s: The producer should help the set decorator, the prop person, and the costume manager to get everything they need.
ex.t: 制作人应该帮助布景师、道具师和服装经理拿到他们需要的一切。

ex.s: The hotel manager realises he has made a mistake.
ex.t: 酒店经理意识到他犯了一个错误。
